articles.titleCn: 政策并非能力：某些安全基准衡量的是你基于哪种“不安全”的定义进行训练
articles.abstractCn: 据报道，一种防护栏分类器被视作文本属性，但实际上并非如此：它是策略的属性，而策略通过其标签进入模型。我们利用了一次工业部署中的意外情况，其中相同的~53k提示被根据两种操作定义（“这是有害内容的请求吗？”和“管理员会封禁它吗？”）进行了两次标注，并用于训练十个共享架构、代码库和优化器系列的防护栏分支，分别在两个模型规模下进行。首先，防护栏自身的训练语料库已经包含了基准数据：JailbreakBench-benign占训练池的88%，OR-Bench-hard占82%，这两个是过度拒绝基准，防护栏报告它们以证明自己没有过度封禁。以下所有内容都已净化。其次，安全基准根据多少分数由标签定义而非模型决定而显著分层：在架构和优化器固定的情况下，十个分支之间的范围在HarmBench-copyright上是0.99，在WildGuard-benign上是0.043，差距达23倍。第三，基准分数可以通过0.03%的参数在整个范围内移动。在这些分支中，HarmBench-copyright范围从0到100，OR-Bench-hard过度拒绝范围从3.4%到56.4%，而最后监督信号携带特定策略的四个分支位于两个极端（精确排名p=0.005，最坏情况下为0.04-0.14），检测能力保持不变。对于精炼的学生模型，教师的软标签即使每个硬标签携带其他策略也能做到这一点，因此教师来源在任何发布的检查点中都是一个未记录的混杂因素。第四，在唯一一个对全部二十个分支进行评分的验证集上，准确率跟踪与标注者的策略一致性（rho=+0.74），而非检测能力（rho=+0.34）。我们认为，防护栏评估应该报告污染情况、种子下限以及它们被评分所依据的定义，作为一级变量。

articles.title: P2N: Reusing Deep Representations for Greater Effective Depth
articles.abstract: Mathematical problem solving and autonomous agents are increasingly important applications of language models, demanding stronger reasoning capabilities. Computational depth is a key resource for such reasoning, but adding model layers increases both training and inference costs, while test-time scaling incurs substantial additional inference computation. We introduce P2N (Previous to Next), which reuses the previous token's deep representations, already available during generation, to increase effective computational depth with negligible decoding overhead. Specifically, P2N adds the previous token's deep hidden state to the current token's shallow representation, allowing subsequent layers to build on previously completed deep computation. This recurrence extends effective computational depth across tokens, while introducing only a single vector addition per decoding step. We train the recurrence using parallel Jacobi updates restricted to a middle-layer core. Experiments with Qwen-style models show that, at 1.5B parameters, P2N improves GSM8K accuracy by over 10 percentage points under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting, with nearly unchanged decoding latency. The benefits also extend to language modeling and average performance on general downstream benchmarks. on general downstream benchmarks.
articles.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures
articles.titleCn: P2N：复用深度表征以实现更有效的深度
articles.abstractCn: 数学问题解决和自主智能体是语言模型日益重要的应用，这要求更强的推理能力。计算深度是这种推理的关键资源，但增加模型层数会同时提高训练和推理成本，而测试时扩展则会导致大量额外的推理计算。我们引入了P2N（Previous to Next），它重用已生成过程中可用的先前标记的深度表示，以在可忽略的解码开销下增加有效计算深度。具体来说，P2N将先前标记的深度隐藏状态添加到当前标记的浅层表示中，允许后续层基于先前完成的深度计算进行构建。这种递归扩展了跨标记的有效计算深度，而每一步解码仅需引入一个向量加法。我们使用仅限于中间层核心的并行雅可比更新来训练这种递归。在Qwen风格模型上的实验表明，在1.5B参数下，P2N在零样本和少样本提示下均将GSM8K准确率提高了超过10个百分点，解码延迟几乎未变。这些优势也扩展到了语言建模和一般下游基准测试的平均性能。

articles.title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
articles.abstract: Model--harness co-evolution has emerged as a prominent paradigm for recursive self-improving (RSI) agents, jointly evolving their execution scaffolds and intrinsic capabilities. We study the persistent yet often overlooked brain--body mismatch problem in this paradigm, where an evolving harness (body) demands behaviors its model (brain) has not learned or restricts capabilities it already possesses. We introduce CoEvo-RSI, a RSI framework that advances model--harness co-evolution through agent-driven, bidirectional historical inheritance. Drawing on a shared evolutionary archive and execution feedback, a meta-agent coordinates harness development from historical designs with model checkpoint selection or merging and subsequent adaptation under the selected harness, aligning inherited capabilities with evolving execution requirements to reduce brain--body mismatch. Using only supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on its own rejection-sampled trajectories, CoEvo-RSI makes Qwen3.5-9B competitive with larger models across diverse vertical applications, including multi-agent failure attribution, role-aware text-to-SQL, and smart-home instruction following. It surpasses DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TraceElephant (+14.16 agent accuracy) and GLM-5.3 on HomeBench VM (+4.90 success rate), underscoring the need for brain--body alignment and the potential of bidirectional historical inheritance to advance agent co-evolution.
articles.titleCn: CoEvo-RSI：当利用进化时，哪些模型应跟随？
articles.abstractCn: 模型- harness 协进化已成为递归自我改进（RSI）智能体的一种突出范式，它们共同进化其执行框架和内在能力。我们研究了这一范式中持续存在但常被忽视的大脑-身体不匹配问题，即一个进化的 harness（身体）要求其 model（大脑）尚未学习的行为，或限制其已具备的能力。我们引入了 CoEvo-RSI，这是一个通过智能体驱动的双向历史继承来推进模型- harness 协进化的 RSI 框架。基于共享的进化档案和执行反馈，一个元智能体协调 harness 开发，从历史设计中选择或合并模型检查点，并在选定的 harness 下进行后续适应，以使继承的能力与不断变化的执行需求相匹配，从而减少大脑-身体不匹配。仅通过对其拒绝采样的轨迹进行监督微调（SFT），CoEvo-RSI 使 Qwen3.5-9B 在包括多智能体故障归因、角色感知文本到 SQL 和智能家居指令遵循等多样化垂直应用中与更大模型具有竞争力。它在 TraceElephant 上超越了 DeepSeek-V4-Pro（智能体准确率提升 14.16%），在 HomeBench VM 上超越了 GLM-5.3（成功率提升 4.90%），这突显了大脑-身体对齐的必要性以及双向历史继承在推进智能体协进化方面的潜力。

articles.title: Dual-Slot: From Serial Loops to Parallel Slots in Language Models
articles.abstract: Looped language models increase computational depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to improve model quality without adding parameters. However, sequential dependencies between loop iterations increase autoregressive decoding latency. We introduce Dual-Slot, an architecture that reorganizes serial looped computation into parallel latent and prediction slots. Rather than waiting for the current token's latent computation to finish, the prediction slot combines the previous token's deep latent state with the current representation, while the latent slot produces a state for the next decoding step. This shifts the latent dependency across adjacent tokens, replacing two sequential module invocations with a single paired invocation while preserving standard autoregressive generation. To preserve token-level parallelism during training, we use a small number of Jacobi iterations to refine latent states across the sequence in parallel. Experiments on Qwen-style dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models show consistent improvements in language modeling and average downstream accuracy. On the 1B dense model, Dual-Slot reduces Pile validation perplexity from 7.25 to 7.00 and improves average five-shot accuracy across nine task configurations by 2.26 percentage points. After supervised fine-tuning, it improves zero-shot GSM8K accuracy by 5.83 and 3.49 percentage points for the 1B dense and A0.6B MoE models, respectively. Across the evaluated batch sizes, Dual-Slot retains 93.1-96.5% of vanilla decoding throughput for the dense model and 98.1-99.6% for the MoE model.
articles.comment: 17 pages, 6 figures
articles.titleCn: 双槽：从串行循环到并行槽位在语言模型中
articles.abstractCn: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层来增加计算深度，提供了一种在不增加参数的情况下提升模型质量的方法。然而，循环迭代之间的顺序依赖性增加了自回归解码的延迟。我们引入了Dual-Slot架构，该架构将串行循环计算重新组织为并行潜在和预测槽。它不再等待当前令牌的潜在计算完成，而是预测槽将前一个令牌的深层潜在状态与当前表示相结合，而潜在槽为下一个解码步骤生成状态。这使潜在依赖性转移到相邻令牌之间，用单个成对调用替换了两个顺序模块调用，同时保留了标准的自回归生成。为了在训练过程中保持令牌级别的并行性，我们使用少量Jacobi迭代并行地优化序列中的潜在状态。在Qwen风格的密集和专家混合（MoE）模型上的实验显示，语言建模和平均下游准确率均有持续提升。在1B密集模型上，Dual-Slot将Pile验证困惑度从7.25降至7.00，并在九种任务配置下将平均五样本准确率提高了2.26个百分点。在监督微调后，它将1B密集和A0.6B MoE模型的零样本GSM8K准确率分别提高了5.83和3.49个百分点。在评估的批处理大小范围内，Dual-Slot为密集模型保留了93.1-96.5%的原始解码吞吐量，为MoE模型保留了98.1-99.6%。

articles.title: Beyond Factual Accuracy: A Benchmark for Evaluating Perspective Alignment in LLMs
articles.abstract: Large Language Models often generate factually correct responses that fail to maintain user-requested perspectives, blending multiple perspectives and forcing users to filter through unwanted information---a perspective control failure that factual accuracy metrics cannot detect. We introduce PerspectiveBench, a benchmark quantifying perspective alignment by constructing scenarios where multiple valid reasoning paths coexist, and propose the Perspective Alignment Score (PAS) to measure adherence to specified perspectives. Experiments reveal that state-of-the-art models successfully include target content but fail to exclude non-requested perspectives. Providing documents through RAG improves factual grounding but does not resolve perspective drift, as models prioritize comprehensive coverage over strict user constraints. Code and data are available at https://github.com/sunghoon014/PerspectiveBench.
articles.titleCn: 超越事实准确性：评估大型语言模型视角一致性的基准
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型常生成事实正确的回答，却无法保持用户要求的视角，混合多种视角并迫使用户筛选不必要的信息——这是一种事实准确性指标无法检测的视角控制失效。我们引入PerspectiveBench，这是一个通过构建共存多种有效推理路径的场景来量化视角一致性的基准，并提出视角一致性分数（PAS）来衡量对指定视角的遵循程度。实验表明，最先进的模型虽然成功包含了目标内容，却未能排除非请求的视角。通过RAG提供文档可提高事实基础性，但无法解决视角偏移问题，因为模型优先考虑全面覆盖而非严格遵循用户约束。代码和数据可在https://github.com/sunghoon014/PerspectiveBench获取。

articles.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining. Continued pretraining risks catastrophic forgetting, while retrieval at inference time can add substantial overhead. External parametric memory avoids online retrieval, but constructing its training data requires extensive offline search, and output-level interpolation provides only shallow fusion. We introduce Deep Fusion Memory (DFM), a parametric memory architecture that reduces this construction workload and incorporates learned memory into intermediate hidden states. A causal memory predictor learns to generate memory from the preceding context, using retrieved chunk embeddings from the corpus as supervision. The predicted memory is shared across tokens within each chunk and fused into their hidden states through gated cross-attention. Memory prediction and fusion are trained end to end with the backbone frozen, and inference requires no explicit retrieval. Compared with existing parametric memory approaches, which often construct token-level memory targets, DFM requires $32\times$ fewer retrieval queries and $2048\times$ fewer retrieved items to construct its training data. Across six QA tasks, DFM performs better over the strongest baseline by 12.71% on Mistral-7B-v0.3 and 11.19% on Qwen3-8B-Base. Beyond QA, domain adaptation yields average gains of 6.51 and 4.38 points over Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, respectively.
articles.titleCn: 深度融合内存：大型语言模型的块级参数化内存
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型需要有效的方法来获取和使用超出其预训练阶段保留的外部知识。持续的预训练存在灾难性遗忘的风险，而推理时的检索会增加相当大的开销。外部参数化记忆避免了在线检索，但其训练数据的构建需要大量的离线搜索，而输出级别的插值只能提供浅层融合。我们引入了深度融合记忆（DFM），一种参数化记忆架构，它减少了这种构建工作量，并将学习到的记忆融入中间隐藏状态中。因果记忆预测器学习从先前的上下文中生成记忆，使用从语料库中检索的块嵌入作为监督。预测的记忆在块内的每个标记之间共享，并通过门控交叉注意力融合到它们的隐藏状态中。记忆预测和融合在主干网络冻结的情况下进行端到端训练，推理时无需显式检索。与现有的参数化记忆方法相比，这些方法通常构建标记级别的记忆目标，DFM构建其训练数据所需的检索查询减少了32倍，检索项减少了2048倍。在六个问答任务中，DFM在Mistral-7B-v0.3上比最强的基线提高了12.71%，在Qwen3-8B-Base上提高了11.19%。除了问答之外，领域自适应分别比Qwen3-4B-Base和Qwen3-8B-Base平均提高了6.51和4.38分。

articles.title: Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation
articles.abstract: The state of the art techniques in Machine Translation (MT) require large amounts of symmetric resources from source and target languages. This is true regardless of whether the approach is Transfer or Interlingua, Symbolic or Statistical. Symmetry within these approaches is necessary to ensure quality, robustness and retargetability. In reality, such symmetry, whether it is in terms of structural transfer lexicons, interlingual dictionaries or parallel corpora, is a major bottleneck in developing any MT system. This dissertation presents an approach to MT that addresses the lack of symmetry by exploiting symbolic and statistical target language resources in source-poor/target-rich language pairs. This approach is called Generation-Heavy Hybrid Machine Translation (GHMT). Expected source language resources include a syntactic parser and a simple one-to-many translation dictionary. No transfer rules or complex interlingual representations are used. Rich target language symbolic resources are used to overgenerate multiple structural variations from a target-glossed syntactic dependency representation of source language sentences. Statistical target-language resource are then used to select amongst the overgenerated translations. The source-target asymmetry of systems developed in this approach makes them more easily retargetable to new source languages.
articles.comment: Dissertation submitted to the Faculty of the Graduate School of the University of Maryland at College Park in partial fulfillment of the requirements for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy 2003
articles.titleCn: 生成密集型混合机器翻译
articles.abstractCn: 当前机器翻译（MT）领域的先进技术需要大量对称的资源，包括源语言和目标语言。无论采用迁移或中间语言方法，符号或统计方法，这种对称性都是必要的，以确保质量、鲁棒性和可重定位性。实际上，这种对称性，无论是结构迁移词典、中间语言词典还是平行语料库，都是开发任何MT系统的主要瓶颈。本论文提出了一种解决对称性缺失问题的MT方法，该方法利用源语言匮乏/目标语言丰富的语言对中的符号和统计目标语言资源。这种方法被称为“生成密集型混合机器翻译”（GHMT）。预期的源语言资源包括句法解析器和简单的单对多翻译词典。不使用迁移规则或复杂的中间语言表示。利用丰富的目标语言符号资源，从源语言句子的目标语言注释句法依存表示中生成多种结构变体。然后使用统计目标语言资源从过度生成的翻译中选择。该方法开发系统中的源目标不对称性使其更容易重新定位到新的源语言。

articles.title: Behave Like Experts: Fusing Data with Semantic Knowledge for Effective and Efficient Semantic Map Construction
articles.abstract: Semantic map models (SMMs) construct a graph that reflects conceptual similarity by comparing cross-lingual form-meaning mappings. Experts build such models not only by obeying the data constraint, i.e., the connectivity hypothesis, which states that conceptual nodes belonging to the same form must be connected, but also by incorporating their prior semantic knowledge. Current automatic methods ignore this knowledge, which harms both accuracy and efficiency by enlarging the search space of candidate graphs. In this paper, we fuse the distributional semantic knowledge hidden in the internal representations of language models into a top-down, data-driven algorithm. This expert-like behavior re-sorts the candidates in a huge search space, guided by conceptual semantics similarity. Experiments on a self-collected benchmark of 10 datasets and comprehensive metrics show that our method builds SMMs both effectively and efficiently.
articles.titleCn: 像专家一样行动：融合数据与语义知识以实现高效且有效的语义地图构建
articles.abstractCn: 语义地图模型（SMMs）通过比较跨语言形式-意义映射来构建一个反映概念相似性的图。专家构建此类模型不仅遵循数据约束，即连通性假设，该假设指出属于同一形式的概念节点必须相互连接，而且还融入了他们先验的语义知识。当前自动方法忽略了这种知识，通过扩大候选图的搜索空间，从而损害了准确性和效率。在本文中，我们将语言模型内部表示中隐藏的分布语义知识融合到一个自上而下、数据驱动的算法中。这种类似专家的行为在巨大的搜索空间中重新排序候选图，并由概念语义相似性进行指导。在包含10个数据集的自收集基准测试和综合指标的综合评估表明，我们的方法在构建SMMs时既有效又高效。

articles.title: Memories That Outlive Their Reasons: Dependency-Tethered Memory for Tool-Using LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Agents now act on the Web, publishing packages, models and datasets through registry APIs, and remembering past verifications spares them the work. But a verdict rests on premises. When a signing key is revoked, everything built on it stops passing, yet the advisory names only the key, and the old verdicts of its dependents may never share a retrieval window with it. This non-locality of invalidation turns memory into a liability: in long simulated chats, an agent reading a memory of atomic facts publishes 62% of the objects whose failure lies upstream, each backed by a record that was true when written. Yet derivation is local even when invalidation is not. Tether records, at write time, the exact versions each verdict derives from, and at read time withdraws any verdict whose support has failed anywhere in the store; the agent reads the same fields as before. On Fallout, a generator of versioned worlds with hypothesis-blind simulated histories shared by every memory, Tether publishes 0.3% of upstream-failing objects across three domains when relations are stated with their verdicts, with 37% fewer verification calls than checking everything. A-Mem and Graphiti re-verify most candidates (0.83-0.86 checks per candidate), which limits their savings, yet publish 9% of upstream-failing objects; Mem0 relies on memory more and publishes 42%. Flushing every verdict on any failure is as safe as Tether but costs 32% more checks. The gain over fact memory holds with three open-weight backbones and against a whole-store window. These gains depend on capturing dependencies: when relations arrive in sessions apart from their verdicts, Tether's downstream unsafe publication rate rises to 9.4-22.1%, and a weak writer that misses edges loses safety in the same way.
articles.titleCn: 超越其缘由的记忆：用于工具使用型LLM代理的依赖式记忆
articles.abstractCn: 代理现在在网络上运行，通过注册API发布软件包、模型和数据集，并且记住过去的验证可以节省工作量。但判决依赖于前提。当签名密钥被吊销时，所有基于它的构建都停止通过，但建议仅命名密钥，其依赖项的旧判决可能永远不会与它共享检索窗口。这种无效性的非局部性将记忆变成一种负债：在长时间的模拟对话中，读取原子事实记忆的代理发布62%的上游失败对象，每个对象都附有写入时为真的记录。然而，即使无效性不是局部的，推导也是局部的。在写入时，Tether记录每个判决的确切来源版本，在读取时撤回任何支持在存储中任何地方失败的判决；代理读取与之前相同的字段。在Fallout上，一个生成带假设盲模拟历史的版本化世界的生成器，每个记忆共享这些历史，当关系与其判决一起声明时，Tether在三个域中发布0.3%的上游失败对象，验证调用次数比检查所有内容减少37%。A-Mem和Graphiti重新验证大多数候选者（每个候选者0.83-0.86次检查），这限制了它们的节省，但发布9%的上游失败对象；Mem0更多地依赖记忆，发布42%。在任何失败上清除所有判决与Tether一样安全，但检查次数增加32%。这些收益在三个开放权重主干和整个存储窗口下仍然保持。这些收益依赖于捕获依赖关系：当关系在其判决之外到达会话时，Tether的下游不安全发布率上升到9.4-22.1%，并且一个遗漏边的弱写入者以相同的方式失去安全性。

articles.title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: Skill-augmented agentic RL has emerged as an effective approach to improving LLM agents on long-horizon tasks. Despite this progress, individual skills may follow distinct trajectories as the policy evolves, with some becoming redundant after the model internalizes their capabilities, others remaining valuable as external scaffolding, and still others turning harmful. However, existing skill library systems fail to identify each skill's true contribution due to free-riding among co-retrieved skills, difficulty confounding across tasks, and the absence of skill-specific counterfactual evidence, which prevents reliable skill lifecycle management. We propose TrackRL, an agentic RL framework where skill tracking drives skill library full lifecycle management. Specifically, within each GRPO group, we turn grouped sampling into online randomized controlled experiments. Independent random injection and within-group contrasts on the same task isolate each skill's true contribution, and reliability-weighted aggregation accumulates evidence across groups. As evidence accumulates, we continuously track skill utility, which measures the skill's causal contribution as external scaffolding, and model mastery, which reflects how far the corresponding capability has been internalized. Along this line, we formulate skill lifecycle management as an evidence-gated state-transition process that governs each skill from generation and admission through protected incubation to retention, retirement, or removal, while a soft capacity bound controls library growth. Experiments show that TrackRL outperforms recent skill-augmented RL baselines in both library-assisted and skill-free evaluation, with further analyses revealing how skill value shifts during policy learning and how evidence-driven state transitions shape skill library evolution. Our code is available at https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL.
articles.titleCn: 可追踪技能库生命周期管理在自主强化学习中
articles.abstractCn: 技能增强型代理强化学习已成为提升长时程任务中大型语言模型代理的有效方法。尽管取得了这些进展，但随着策略的演变，各个技能可能会遵循不同的轨迹：一些技能在模型内化其能力后变得冗余，另一些技能作为外部支撑仍然有价值，还有一些技能则可能变得有害。然而，现有的技能库系统由于协同检索技能中的搭便车现象、跨任务混淆的困难以及缺乏特定技能的对照证据，无法识别每个技能的真实贡献，这阻碍了可靠的技能生命周期管理。我们提出了TrackRL，这是一个代理强化学习框架，其中技能跟踪驱动技能库全生命周期管理。具体而言，在每个GRPO组内，我们将分组采样转化为在线随机对照实验。在相同任务上的独立随机注入和组内对比可以隔离每个技能的真实贡献，而可靠性加权聚合则跨组累积证据。随着证据的累积，我们持续跟踪技能效用，该指标衡量技能作为外部支撑的因果贡献，以及模型掌握度，该指标反映相应能力被内化的程度。在此基础上，我们将技能生命周期管理公式化为一个证据门控的状态转换过程，该过程管理每个技能从生成和准入，通过受保护的孵化，到保留、退休或移除，同时一个软容量边界控制库的增长。实验表明，TrackRL在库辅助和技能无辅助评估中均优于近期的技能增强型强化学习基线，进一步的分析揭示了策略学习过程中技能价值的转变，以及证据驱动的状态转换如何塑造技能库的演变。我们的代码可在https://github.com/xizhu1022/TrackRL获取。

articles.title: MemBubble: Benchmarking How Agent Memory Shapes LLM Response Diversity
articles.abstract: Memory serves as the core component of LLM-based agents, enabling personalized responses via extracting and using user preferences from past interactions. However, its use may reduce response diversity, thereby narrowing the range of information available to users. Existing evaluations rely largely on synthetic interactions and cover few memory systems, leaving the effects of memory on response diversity insufficiently evaluated in real-world scenarios. We introduce MemBubble, a benchmark of 1000 instances built on preferences extracted from real user-assistant conversations. To measure the extent to which memory concentrates response distributions, we construct test queries in scenarios distinct from user preferences while preserving topical relevance through shared preference categories. Across multiple LLMs and memory mechanisms, entropy decreases by 34.7% on average compared with directly providing the full interaction history, highlighting the important role of memory processing in diversity loss. We also explore simple user-side interventions and changes in information availability but find that these do not effectively close the diversity gap. Our findings highlight the need to consider preserving diversity and user access to information alongside improvements in personalization when designing and using agent memory systems.
articles.titleCn: MemBubble：基准测试代理记忆如何塑造大语言模型响应多样性
articles.abstractCn: 记忆是LLM（大型语言模型）代理的核心组件，通过提取和使用用户在过往交互中的偏好，实现个性化响应。然而，其使用可能会降低响应多样性，从而缩小用户可获取的信息范围。现有的评估主要依赖合成交互，且覆盖的记忆系统较少，导致记忆对响应多样性的影响在现实场景中未能得到充分评估。我们引入了MemBubble，这是一个基于从真实用户-助手对话中提取的偏好构建的包含1000个实例的基准。为了衡量记忆集中响应分布的程度，我们在与用户偏好不同的场景中构建测试查询，同时通过共享的偏好类别保留主题相关性。在多个LLM和记忆机制中，与直接提供完整交互历史相比，熵平均降低了34.7%，突显了记忆处理在多样性损失中的重要作用。我们还探索了简单的用户端干预和信息可用性变化，但发现这些方法并未能有效缩小多样性差距。我们的研究结果表明，在设计和使用代理记忆系统时，除了改进个性化之外，还应考虑保留多样性和用户获取信息的需求。

articles.title: TIRE: Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution for Physics Problem Synthesis
articles.abstract: Advancing physics reasoning in large language models requires scalable training data that connect physical laws, concrete problem scenarios, and verifiable numerical answers. Expert-designed problems offer top-down control over physical laws, conditions, and scenarios, but require costly human effort. LLM-based synthesis from texts scales efficiently, but model-generated answers and assessments leave supervision vulnerable to hallucinations. We introduce TIRE, a framework for Top-Down Formula Instantiation with Reliable Execution that brings knowledge-driven problem construction to large-scale data generation. Top-down instantiation uses reusable physical formulas and their applicability conditions to control the physical relations and numerical configurations of generated problems. Reliable execution establishes reference answers before problem generation, providing a common numerical foundation for problem construction and teacher distillation. Together, these mechanisms combine control over problem content with execution-grounded supervision for both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Using TIRE, we construct TIRE-19k, spanning nine subfields of physics. Across 3 backbone LLMs and 4 benchmarks, TIRE-19k outperforms 5 representative datasets with equal amounts of SFT data, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.86 percentage points on average. Further GRPO raises Qwen3-8B's average accuracy by 1.52 percentage points over its TIRE-19k SFT checkpoint. These results demonstrate the value of generating physics training data from explicit physical knowledge with reliable execution.
articles.titleCn: 轮胎：用于物理问题合成的自顶向下公式实例化与可靠执行
articles.abstractCn: 推进大型语言模型中的物理推理需要能够连接物理定律、具体问题场景和可验证数值答案的可扩展训练数据。专家设计的问题能够自上而下地控制物理定律、条件和场景，但需要耗费大量人力。基于文本的合成能够高效扩展，但模型生成的答案和评估容易受到幻觉的监督漏洞。我们引入了TIRE框架，即自上而下公式实例化与可靠执行框架，将知识驱动的 问题构建应用于大规模数据生成。自上而下实例化利用可重用的物理公式及其适用条件来控制生成问题的物理关系和数值配置。可靠执行在问题生成前建立参考答案，为问题构建和教师蒸馏提供共同的数值基础。这些机制结合了对问题内容的控制以及基于执行的监督，适用于监督微调和强化学习。使用TIRE，我们构建了TIRE-19k数据集，涵盖物理学的九个子领域。在3个主干LLM和4个基准测试中，TIRE-19k在具有相同SFT数据量的5个代表性数据集上表现更优，平均超出最强基线2.86个百分点。进一步的GRPO将Qwen3-8B的平均准确率在其TIRE-19k SFT检查点基础上提高了1.52个百分点。这些结果表明，通过可靠的执行从明确的物理知识生成物理训练数据具有重要价值。

articles.title: PLANE: Plug-and-Play Fine-Grained Visual Experts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly suffer from hallucinations, which appear as fabricating non-existent objects or outputting incorrect attributes and spatial relationships in images. Previous works empirically indicate that CLIP-style vision encoders tend to focus on primary objects while ignoring image details, which is one of the causes of hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose plug-and-play fine-grained visual experts (PLANE) comprising two components: LoRA visual experts operating on CLIP for multi-aspect image encoding, and an instruction-aware gate network for adaptive image feature fusion. During training, we construct a fine-grained image-caption pairs dataset, where images are described from three aspects: objects, attributes, and relations between objects. Image-caption pairs from different aspects are used to train the three fine-grained LoRA experts respectively. Aiming at comprehensively evaluate our method's capabilities, we manually annotate a fine-grained hallucination evaluation benchmark for LVLMs which is GPT4-independent during evaluation phase (GIFT). We conduct experiments both on popular hallucination evaluation benchmarks and GIFT. The results show that our method effectively reduces hallucinations across models of different types and sizes while introducing minimal inference latency. Compared to advanced baselines, our model also demonstrates superior performance.
articles.comment: Accepted by EMNLP2026 Findings
articles.titleCn: 平面：即插即用细粒度视觉专家，用于大型视觉语言模型的幻觉缓解
articles.abstractCn: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在幻觉现象，表现为虚构不存在物体或输出图像中错误的属性和空间关系。先前研究通过实证表明，CLIP风格的视觉编码器倾向于关注主要物体而忽略图像细节，这是导致幻觉现象的原因之一。为解决这一问题，我们提出了即插即用的细粒度视觉专家（PLANE）模型，该模型包含两个组件：在CLIP上运行的LoRA视觉专家进行多方面图像编码，以及用于自适应图像特征融合的指令感知门控网络。在训练过程中，我们构建了一个细粒度的图像-文本对数据集，其中图像从三个方面进行描述：物体、属性以及物体之间的关系。来自不同方面的图像-文本对分别用于训练三个细粒度的LoRA专家。为了全面评估我们方法的能力，我们手动标注了一个适用于LVLMs的细粒度幻觉评估基准，该基准在评估阶段独立于GPT4（GIFT）。我们在流行的幻觉评估基准和GIFT上进行了实验。结果表明，我们的方法有效减少了不同类型和规模的模型中的幻觉现象，同时引入了极小的推理延迟。与先进的基线模型相比，我们的模型也表现出更优越的性能。

articles.title: Morpheus: a fully local, defense-in-depth de-identification engine for Greek clinical text - a benchmark evaluation
articles.abstract: Background and Objective: Clinical free text cannot leave the hospital without de-identification, yet no de-identification system or benchmark exists for Greek clinical text. We evaluated Morpheus, a fully local de-identification pipeline for Greek clinical documents, on 500 synthetic discharge summaries. Methods: The notes (300 cardiac surgery, 100 cardiology, 100 nephrology) were generated by a frontier large language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) constrained to authentic Greek hospital document layouts. Notes were pre-annotated at generation; two clinicians then independently reviewed and corrected every note, blinded to each other, with disagreements arbitrated. Primary outcomes were recall over must-redact identifiers and over-redaction of clinical content, measured over must-survive probes. Secondary outcomes: residual leaks flagged by an independent egress-review layer, processing time and reproducibility. Results: Inter-annotator agreement was F1 = 0.998. The de-identification rate was 96.59% (7,666/7,937 identifier instances; 95% CI 96.16-96.96): 98.49% for direct and 93.42% for quasi-identifiers. No patient's own complete identifier survived in any note; of 271 residual instances, 199 (73.4%) concerned institutional identity, chiefly the hospital letterhead. The over-redaction rate was 2.82% (190/6,747 probes; 95% CI 2.45-3.24). The egress guard flagged 2 of 271 residuals, both complete telephone numbers. Two independent runs gave identical verdicts. Conclusions: A fully local, deterministic pipeline removed 98.5% of direct patient identifiers from Greek clinical text while altering under 3% of protected clinical content; most residuals concerned the institution, not the patient. To our knowledge this is the first benchmark evaluation of clinical-text de-identification for Greek and the first quantified evaluation of an independent egress-guard layer.

articles.titleCn: 莫尔菲厄斯：一个针对希腊临床文本的完全本地化、纵深防御去识别化引擎——基准评估
articles.abstractCn: 背景与目的：临床自由文本未经去识别化不能离开医院，然而目前希腊临床文本尚无去识别化系统或基准。我们对Morpheus——一个用于希腊临床文档的完全本地化去识别化流程——在500份合成出院记录上进行了评估。方法：这些记录（300份心脏外科、100份心脏病学、100份肾脏病学）由一个前沿大型语言模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro）在真实的希腊医院文档布局约束下生成。记录在生成时进行了预标注；两位临床医生独立地、互盲地审查和修正每份记录，分歧由第三方仲裁。主要结果是在必须去识别化的标识符和临床内容过度去识别化方面的召回率，通过必须存活的探针进行测量。次要结果：独立出口审查层标记的残余泄露、处理时间和可重复性。结果：标注者间一致性为F1 = 0.998。去识别化率为96.59%（7,666/7,937个标识符实例；95% CI 96.16-96.96）：直接标识符为98.49%，准标识符为93.42%。没有任何记录中患者完整标识符得以存活；在271个残余实例中，199个（73.4%）涉及机构身份，主要是医院信头。过度去识别化率为2.82%（190/6,747个探针；95% CI 2.45-3.24）。出口审查层标记了271个残余实例中的2个，均为完整电话号码。两次独立运行给出了相同的判断。结论：一个完全本地化、确定性的流程从希腊临床文本中移除了98.5%的直接患者标识符，同时改变了不到3%的保护临床内容；大多数残余涉及机构而非患者。据我们所知，这是首次对希腊临床文本去识别化进行基准评估，也是首次对独立出口审查层进行量化评估。

articles.title: Do LLMs Reproduce the Age Gap in Loneliness? Evaluating Survey Simulation against European Survey Data
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are often used to simulate survey respondents, but matching survey averages does not establish accurate demographic differences. We test whether LLM outputs reproduce within-country age gaps in loneliness using the 2022 EU Loneliness Survey, comparing adults aged 18-34 and 65 or older in France, Italy, Poland, and Sweden. We evaluate simulation with and without age information and direct distribution estimation against a probability-based sample, with a non-probability sensitivity reference. Both human samples show higher mean loneliness among younger adults. Under age-specified simulation with standard response-option order, Mistral Small 4 and GPT-5.6 Terra reverse this ordering under all three prompt framings in three and two countries, respectively, mainly by overestimating older-adult means. DeepSeek V4 Flash preserves the ordering everywhere but underestimates both group means, with errors largely cancelling in France and Italy. Against the probability-based reference, direct estimation has lower absolute age-gap error than simulation for Mistral and Terra in every country. For DeepSeek, simulation has lower gap error but direct estimation has lower group-mean error; these comparisons depend on low-validity older-adult simulation cells. Evaluating LLM outputs as proxies for age groups within countries therefore requires checking both group means and their contrast against human survey data.
articles.titleCn: LLMs是否复制了孤独感的年龄差距？评估调查模拟与欧洲调查数据
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）常被用于模拟调查受访者，但匹配调查平均值并不能建立准确的群体差异。我们使用2022年欧盟孤独感调查，测试LLM输出是否能重现国家内部的年龄孤独感差距，比较了法国、意大利、波兰和瑞典18-34岁和65岁以上的成年人。我们评估了包含和不包含年龄信息的模拟，以及直接分布估计与概率样本的对比，并参考了非概率敏感性样本。两个人类样本都显示年轻成年人的平均孤独感更高。在年龄指定的模拟中，使用标准选项顺序时，Mistral Small 4和GPT-5.6 Terra在三个和两个国家中分别逆转了这一顺序，主要是通过高估老年人的平均值。DeepSeek V4 Flash在所有情况下都保持了顺序，但低估了两个群体的平均值，在法国和意大利误差基本抵消。与概率参考相比，Mistral和Terra在所有国家中直接估计的绝对年龄差距误差都低于模拟。对于DeepSeek，模拟的差距误差较低，但直接估计的群体平均值误差较低；这些比较依赖于低效的老年人模拟单元。因此，将LLM输出作为国家内部年龄群体的代理需要检查两个群体的平均值及其与人类调查数据的对比。

articles.title: Legal Guidance in the Wild: How Users Seek Legal Help in Real-World LLM Conversations
articles.abstract: People ask conversational AI models about their legal rights, obligations, procedures, and personal situations that may have legal consequences. To study this behavior, we first need to distinguish requests for legal guidance from other legally themed discussions and unrelated conversations. We contribute a multi-axis taxonomy of legal queries capturing whether legal guidance is sought, how a request is formulated, and which legal domains it concerns; apply it to 2,122 naturally occurring WildChat-1M conversations; and create a human-reviewed gold evaluation set of 200 conversations. All annotations, model checkpoints, and evaluation code are publicly available. In this enriched sample, 71.1% of conversations containing legal content seek personalized or practical guidance. Rights-and-options advice is the most common primary request type among legal-content conversations, and 25.3% of guidance-positive conversations span multiple legal topics. The gold evaluation set supports a two-stage comparison of ModernBERT-base and ModernBERT-large against a TF-IDF cascade. Our framework supports large-scale studies of legal guidance in conversational AI, and the public release of the annotated data facilitates reproducible research and future model development.

articles.titleCn: 野外法律指导：用户如何在现实世界中的LLM对话中寻求法律帮助
articles.abstractCn: 人们向对话式AI模型咨询他们的法律权利、义务、程序以及可能产生法律后果的个人情况。为了研究这种行为，我们首先需要将寻求法律指导的请求与其他法律主题的讨论和不相关的对话区分开来。我们提出了一种多维分类法，用于捕捉是否寻求法律指导、请求是如何表述的以及它涉及哪些法律领域；将其应用于2122个自然发生的WildChat-1M对话；并创建了一个由人类评审的200个对话的金标准评估集。所有标注、模型检查点和评估代码都是公开可用的。在这个丰富样本中，71.1%包含法律内容的对话寻求个性化或实用指导。在包含法律内容的对话中，权利和选择建议是最常见的首要请求类型，25.3%的指导性对话涉及多个法律主题。金标准评估集支持ModernBERT-base和ModernBERT-large与TF-IDF级联的两阶段比较。我们的框架支持对话式AI中法律指导的大规模研究，标注数据的公开发布促进了可复现研究和未来的模型开发。

articles.title: Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability
articles.abstract: LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.
articles.titleCn: 不可区分代理：将代理隐私训练为双世界不可区分性
articles.abstractCn: LLM代理为其用户搜索、购物和发送消息，而每个行为都会被某些方看到。现有的隐私训练会奖励代理不提及受保护物品，但观察者可以从代理的行为中推断出私人事实。由于观察者只有在其视角随事实变化时才会学到事实，我们提出了\methodfull（\method），它在仅存在私人事实差异的双世界上进行训练。一个冻结的区分器通过其对真实世界的对数似然比来为每个观察者的视角打分，配对GRPO则基于任务成功减去这个比率来训练代理。我们证明了该目标控制了每个观察者在每个信道上的贝叶斯成功率。在购物和消息任务中，\method消除了披露判断和查询级奖励所遗漏的泄露，同时代理仍然能够完成其任务。

articles.title: Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents
articles.abstract: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.
articles.titleCn: 记忆，了解你的位置：在持久内存代理中管理生命周期状态和查询时资格
articles.abstractCn: 持久化内存将先前的交互转化为持久的代理状态，但现有系统对状态是否保持有效以及是否应影响后续查询的控制有限。我们主张可靠内存需要控制状态形成和查询时影响。我们介绍了PLACE，一个分层的治理层，为内存后端添加了写入侧状态认证和读取侧授权。在Mem0上对Qwen2.5-3B和Qwen2.5-7B进行的因子化评估隔离了每个机制的贡献。结果表明，写入侧治理显著提高了生命周期状态正确性，而读取侧治理消除了在状态正确设置中来自不合格内存的测量因果泄漏。它们的结合实现了最强的联合性能，同时保留了与查询相关的支持。这些发现表明，可靠的持久化内存需要对维护的状态和查询时信息影响进行显式控制。

articles.title: Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

articles.titleCn: 基于用户搜索交互和知识图谱的对话式推荐生成
articles.abstractCn: 大规模对话式推荐数据集通常需要人工构建或标注对话。我们提出了SearCl，该系统基于用户搜索和点击行为自动生成对话式推荐对话。SearCl将用户交互分割为查询会话，并从搜索查询后的内容选择中推导出每个推荐目标。一个可配置的马尔可夫链控制对话流程，同时两个作为寻求者和推荐者的LLM智能体根据回合级约束生成语句。为支持推荐，推荐者被提供从对话中使用的每个内容项元数据构建的知识图谱，捕捉其属性和关系。使用SearCl，我们从内容搜索和点击交互数据中生成了3,538个对话，覆盖1,731个唯一目标项。在LLM作为评判者的协议下，生成的对话比现有基准数据集的对话质量评分更高。这些结果表明SearCl能够实现无需人工标注的可控和知识基础的数据集构建。

articles.title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Toward an Interdisciplinary Study of Meaning Variation
articles.abstract: An increasing number of disciplines recognize the explanatory potential of meaning-bearing mental structures through which individuals interpret the world and guide their behavior. Concept representations constitute a core class of these structures, emerging from individuals' experiences with concept referents and encoding and organizing their understanding of them. Recognizing a private level of meaning, where concepts are not objectively defined by rules in the world but constitute subjective structures in individuals' minds, raises a fundamental question: do different individuals actually mean the same thing when they invoke the same concept? As latent structures, concept representations are difficult to access and model empirically. The present study introduces a measurement framework that makes such representations empirically accessible through textual traces elicited under standardized conditions. Using transformer-based sentence embeddings, the framework maps standardized responses elicited for concepts into a high-dimensional shared vector space, opening concept representations to the systematic analysis of interindividual variation. It develops three analytical avenues: (1) comparing representational sharedness across concepts, (2) identifying variables that correlate with representational variation, and (3) examining how focal actors or subpopulations deviate from a reference population. Each avenue is illustrated through an empirical proof-of-concept drawing on a large-scale free-association dataset. Together, the demonstrations show how researchers from across disciplines can move from a research question and data source to analysis and interpretation. An accompanying GitHub repository provides a ready-to-use implementation of the framework for existing and custom datasets.

articles.titleCn: 向量空间中的概念表示：迈向意义变异的跨学科研究
articles.abstractCn: 越来越多的学科认识到，个体通过意义承载的心理结构来解释世界和指导行为具有解释潜力。概念表征构成了这些结构的核心类别，它们源于个体与概念指称物的经验，并编码和组织他们对这些指称物的理解。认识到一个私人层面的意义，即概念并非由世界中的规则客观定义，而是构成个体头脑中的主观结构，提出了一个基本问题：当不同个体使用相同概念时，他们是否真正意味着同一件事？作为潜在结构，概念表征难以通过经验进行访问和建模。本研究介绍了一种测量框架，通过在标准化条件下诱发的文本痕迹，使这些表征在经验上变得可及。该框架利用基于transformer的句子嵌入，将针对概念的标准化响应映射到高维共享向量空间，从而为个体间差异的系统分析打开了概念表征的大门。它发展了三条分析路径：(1)比较不同概念表征的共享性，(2)识别与表征变异相关的变量，以及(3)考察焦点行动者或亚群体如何偏离参考群体。每条路径都通过一个基于大规模自由联想数据集的概念实证验证来说明。这些演示共同展示了跨学科研究人员如何从研究问题和数据源过渡到分析和解释。一个配套的GitHub仓库提供了适用于现有和自定义数据集的框架现成实现。

articles.title: Reranking Answers of Large Language Models with Knowledge Graphs
articles.abstract: Answering natural language questions over knowledge graph data is challenging due to the vast number of facts, which can be difficult to process and navigate. One potential solution for this issue is to use mined subgraphs related to the query, although this process still requires extracting these subgraphs. This research presents a solution for extracting subgraphs related to entity candidates from a question-and-answer set, which can be obtained by inferring a large language model by calculating the shortest paths between entities. The proposed approaches detail various features that can be extracted from the subgraphs and reranking models to select the most probable answers from a list of candidates. Experiments were conducted on Wikidata to evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed approaches. This involved enumerating all the main feature types that can be extracted from mined subgraphs and a detailed analysis of the proposed features and reranking method combinations. In addition, a public web application that provides a useful web tool for studying the graph space between question and answer entities has been developed to work with subgraphs. This includes visualization of the extracted subgraph and automatic generation of natural language text to describe it.

articles.titleCn: 使用知识图谱对大型语言模型的答案进行重新排序
articles.abstractCn: 在知识图谱数据上回答自然语言问题具有挑战性，因为其中包含大量事实，这些事实难以处理和导航。解决这个问题的一个潜在方案是使用与查询相关的挖掘子图，尽管这个过程仍然需要提取这些子图。本研究提出了一种从问答集中提取与实体候选相关的子图的方法，该方法通过计算实体之间的最短路径来推断大型语言模型。所提出的方法详细描述了可以从子图中提取的各种特征，以及用于从候选列表中选择最可能答案的重新排序模型。在Wikidata上进行了实验，以评估所提出方法的有效性。这包括枚举可以从挖掘的子图中提取的所有主要特征类型，并对所提出的特征和重新排序方法组合进行了详细分析。此外，还开发了一个公共网络应用程序，该应用程序提供了一个有用的网络工具，用于研究问题实体和答案实体之间的图空间，并与子图配合使用。这包括提取子图的可视化以及自动生成自然语言文本来描述它。
